-- OH Senate: Sherrod Brown won D primary with 89.5% — promote to General
-- The R primary winner needs to be set too. AP shows only D primary results.
-- Set status to General since D primary is called (99% reporting)
UPDATE senate_races 
SET status = 'General', primary_winner = 'Sherrod Brown', primary_party = 'D'
WHERE state_code = 'OH' AND is_special = 0;

-- WV Senate: Fix Rachel Fetty Anderson name consistency (AP returned "Rachel Anderson")
UPDATE senate_races 
SET primary_winner = 'Rachel Fetty Anderson'
WHERE state_code = 'WV' AND primary_winner = 'Rachel Anderson';

-- IN-3: Marlin Stutzman ran unopposed in R primary — clear duplicate candidate2
UPDATE house_races 
SET candidate2_name = NULL, candidate2_party = NULL, candidate2_vote_pct = 0, candidate2_votes = 0
WHERE state_code = 'IN' AND district = 3 AND candidate1_name = candidate2_name;

-- IN-4: Jim Baird ran unopposed — clear duplicate
UPDATE house_races 
SET candidate2_name = NULL, candidate2_party = NULL, candidate2_vote_pct = 0, candidate2_votes = 0
WHERE state_code = 'IN' AND district = 4 AND candidate1_name = candidate2_name;

-- IN-7: André Carson ran unopposed — clear duplicate
UPDATE house_races 
SET candidate2_name = NULL, candidate2_party = NULL, candidate2_vote_pct = 0, candidate2_votes = 0
WHERE state_code = 'IN' AND district = 7 AND candidate1_name = candidate2_name;

-- IN-14 (OH-14): Maria Jukic ran unopposed in D primary — clear duplicate
UPDATE house_races 
SET candidate2_name = NULL, candidate2_party = NULL, candidate2_vote_pct = 0, candidate2_votes = 0
WHERE state_code = 'OH' AND district = 14 AND candidate1_name = candidate2_name;
